title: What If a Hurricane Stalled Over a City? Harvey Did

scenes.text: What if a hurricane stopped moving? Over Texas in 2017, one did, and the rain was the record.
Hurricane Harvey weakened inland but stalled for days, dumping rain on the same region without a break.
At one point, nearly seven inches fell in a single hour in southeast Houston.
Houston saw more than 50 inches in four days, slightly less than its whole average year of rain.
A station near Nederland, Texas, recorded 60.58 inches, the largest rainfall from a U.S. storm on record.
More than 300,000 structures flooded. Wind wasn't the danger. Slowness was.

description:
What if a hurricane stalled over a city?
Harvey did in 2017 and dropped 60.58 inches of rain at one station.
